said.q: In Bangkok VII, Gursky produces a highly expressionistic ‘painting’ via photoshop manipulation, by adding the illusion of oil spills onto the surface of the fast-flowing urban water of Chao Phraya river in central Bangkok. It is a footprint of the major concerns that surround Gursky’s oeuvre: it inhabits the middle ground between abstraction and figuration, it explores photographic techniques vis-à-vis painterly devices, and it studies the effects of globalisation on the earth and human psyche.
